{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure highest sample_seq is kept
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Check for site count
print(data['site'].unique())
print(data['site'].value_counts())

# Step 4: Check if sites differ in severity or arm
print(pd.crosstab(data['site'], data['severity']))
print(pd.crosstab(data['site'], data['arm']))"}
